title: 英语语法系统课程
subtitle: 从规则理解走向陌生语料与真实表达
source: 剑桥初级英语语法及迁移训练版整理成果

stages.title: 句子入门
stages.description: 先找句子主干，再掌握否定、提问和简短回应。

review.text: Maya is the new assistant in our office. She checks the schedule every morning. Does she know where the meeting is? I don't think so. Please send her the address. Nobody called her yesterday, did they?

questions.prompt: 找出第一句的主语和系动词。
questions.answer: Maya；is。

questions.prompt: 哪一处用一般现在时表达规律？
questions.answer: She checks the schedule every morning.

questions.prompt: 找出一个一般疑问句。
questions.answer: Does she know where the meeting is?

questions.prompt: 找出嵌入式问句，并说明为何不倒装。
questions.answer: where the meeting is；嵌入句用陈述语序。

questions.prompt: 找出一个礼貌的祈使请求。
questions.answer: Please send her the address.

questions.prompt: 找出附加问句并解释助动词。
questions.answer: did they?；nobody 使前句具有否定意义。

review.writing: 写 80-100 词，向新同事介绍一项日常工作，并礼貌地提出一个请求。
review.check: 至少有一个清晰主干、一个一般现在时句、一个否定句、一个疑问句和一个礼貌请求。

stages.title: 名词与指代
stages.description: 先确定可数性和所指，再选择冠词、物主形式和代词。

review.text: A teacher gave us some useful advice about the project. The advice was simple: choose a topic that interests you. Each student wrote a short plan. Some plans were ambitious, but none of them needed expensive equipment. The teacher's comments helped us revise our ideas.

questions.prompt: 找出一个不可数名词及其限定方式。
questions.answer: advice；some useful advice。

questions.prompt: 找出一个单数可数名词前的冠词。
questions.answer: a topic / a short plan。

questions.prompt: 找出一个物主结构。
questions.answer: The teacher's comments。

questions.prompt: none of them 在这里指代什么？
questions.answer: 前面提到的学生计划。

questions.prompt: 解释 Each student 后为何用 wrote 而非 write。
questions.answer: 此段叙述过去；each student 是单数主语。

questions.prompt: 找出另一个不可数名词。
questions.answer: equipment；不直接加复数 -s。

review.writing: 写 80-100 词介绍一个学习计划，使用冠词、数量词、代词和至少一个所有格。
review.check: 逐一检查单数可数名词的限定词、不可数名词和代词的先行词。

stages.title: 数量与动词基础
stages.description: 数量、主谓一致与基本动词形式是时态学习的地基。

review.text: There are three reports on the desk, and each report has a different purpose. Neither of the first two is complete. The third contains fewer mistakes, but it needs more evidence. Our team reviews reports every Friday. Ten minutes is enough for a first check.

questions.prompt: there are 在此介绍什么？
questions.answer: 介绍桌上存在三份报告。

questions.prompt: each report 为什么配 has？
questions.answer: each report 是单数主语。

questions.prompt: Neither of the first two 指几份报告？
questions.answer: 前两份都不完整。

questions.prompt: fewer mistakes 为什么不用 less？
questions.answer: mistakes 是可数复数。

questions.prompt: 找出一般现在时表达规律的句子。
questions.answer: Our team reviews reports every Friday.

questions.prompt: Ten minutes 后为什么可用 is？
questions.answer: 这里把十分钟看作一个整体时段。

review.writing: 写 80-100 词比较两个方案，至少使用 each、either/neither、可数数量比较和一个 there 句。
review.check: 核对主谓一致、数量词的可数性，以及 it/there 的不同作用。

stages.title: 现在、过去与完成
stages.description: 以参照时间为核心，区分常态、过程、结果和持续。

review.text: I usually work at home, but this week I am working in the library. Yesterday, I was reading when Maya called. She has found a useful article, and we have discussed it twice. I have been taking notes all morning, but I have written only one paragraph.

questions.prompt: 找出常态与暂时过程的对比。
questions.answer: usually work；am working this week。

questions.prompt: 哪个动作是电话来时的背景？
questions.answer: was reading。

questions.prompt: 找出一个明确结束的过去事件。
questions.answer: Maya called（在昨天）。

questions.prompt: 哪个完成时强调截至目前的次数？
questions.answer: have discussed it twice。

questions.prompt: 哪个形式强调持续过程？
questions.answer: have been taking notes all morning。

questions.prompt: 哪个形式强调已经完成的数量？
questions.answer: have written only one paragraph。

review.writing: 写 100-120 词记录昨天到今天的一个项目进展。
review.check: 区分常态、过去事件、过去背景、目前成果和持续过程；不靠关键词机械选时态。

stages.title: 时间视角与可能性
stages.description: 从过去和将来回看事件，学习能力、许可与推断。

review.text: By the time we arrived, the museum had closed. We were going to return the next day, but a guide said we could join a late tour. It might be crowded, he warned. This time tomorrow, we will be visiting the gallery. By Friday, we will have seen the whole collection.

questions.prompt: 为什么用 had closed？
questions.answer: 关门早于我们抵达这个过去参照点。

questions.prompt: were going to return 表什么视角？
questions.answer: 从过去看当时计划的未来。

questions.prompt: could join 表能力、许可还是一次成功？
questions.answer: 此处是有机会/获准参加；并不单靠 could 断定已参加。

questions.prompt: might be crowded 表什么把握？
questions.answer: 可能拥挤，并非确信。

questions.prompt: will be visiting 以哪个时点为参照？
questions.answer: 明天的这个时候。

questions.prompt: will have seen 表到什么时候完成？
questions.answer: 到周五。

review.writing: 写 100-120 词说明一次旅行计划的变化，并预测未来某一时点的进展。
review.check: 至少使用过去完成、一个过去视角的计划、一个不确定推断和一个未来参照点。

stages.title: 情态与被动
stages.description: 区分义务、建议、反事实与信息焦点。

review.text: The forms must be signed today, but you don't have to print them. You should check the names first. I would rather send one clear file than several drafts. The first draft may have been deleted by mistake. The final version is expected to be reviewed tomorrow.

questions.prompt: must be signed 表什么要求和语态？
questions.answer: 必须签署；被动语态。

questions.prompt: don't have to print 是否表示禁止打印？
questions.answer: 不是；表示不必打印。

questions.prompt: should check 的语气是什么？
questions.answer: 建议或应当。

questions.prompt: would rather 后接什么动词形式？
questions.answer: 原形 send。

questions.prompt: may have been deleted 表什么时间和把握？
questions.answer: 对过去可能被删除的推断。

questions.prompt: is expected to be reviewed 是哪种结构？
questions.answer: 转述/预期的被动加不定式被动。

review.writing: 写 100-120 词说明一份文件的处理流程与要求。
review.check: 明确区分必须、禁止、不必、建议和推断；至少用一个合适的被动结构。

stages.title: 使役与非谓语
stages.description: 先辨认后续动作的执行者，再选择 -ing、to 或原形。

review.text: I had my laptop repaired last week. The technician suggested updating the software and asked me to restart the machine. I remembered to save my files first. After checking the settings, I found the screen easy to read. I am used to working on a smaller laptop, but this one is better.

questions.prompt: had my laptop repaired 是否说明“我亲自修理”？
questions.answer: 通常不说明；表示安排别人修理。

questions.prompt: suggested 后为何用 updating？
questions.answer: suggest 常接 -ing，不直接接 someone to do。

questions.prompt: asked me to restart 中谁执行 restart？
questions.answer: me，即叙述者。

questions.prompt: remembered to save 表保存前还是保存后的记忆？
questions.answer: 记得要保存并照做。

questions.prompt: After checking 中 checking 为什么是 -ing？
questions.answer: after 是介词，此处后接 -ing。

questions.prompt: easy to read 与 used to working 中 to 分别是什么？
questions.answer: 前者是不定式标记；后者是介词。

review.writing: 写 100-120 词描述一次请人维修或帮助解决问题的经历。
review.check: 区分自己做与请人做；至少用 suggest doing、ask someone to do 和一个介词+-ing。

stages.title: 修饰与程度
stages.description: 掌握分词修饰、形容词副词、比较和信息范围。

review.text: Having finished the survey, we wrote a short report. The results were surprisingly clear. A carefully designed chart made them easier to compare. Our old process was slower than the new one, but the change was not large enough to justify a full redesign.

questions.prompt: Having finished 的逻辑主语是谁？
questions.answer: we；我们完成调查。

questions.prompt: surprisingly 修饰的范围是什么？
questions.answer: 评价结果清晰得令人意外。

questions.prompt: carefully 修饰哪个动作？
questions.answer: designed；图表经过精心设计。

questions.prompt: A carefully designed chart made them easier to compare 中 them 指代什么？
questions.answer: 前句的 results，即调查结果。

questions.prompt: not large enough to... 表什么？
questions.answer: 变化不够大，因此不足以支持彻底重设计。

questions.prompt: 找出一个前置分词修饰。
questions.answer: A carefully designed chart 中 designed。

review.writing: 写 100-120 词比较旧方法与新方法，解释一次改进为何值得或不值得。
review.check: 用一个分词结构、一个合适的副词、一个比较结构和 enough/too 表程度。

stages.title: 介词与动词搭配
stages.description: 按时间、空间、关系和场景学习，避免逐字直译。

review.text: At nine, we walked into the meeting room. Maya handed out the notes and asked us to write down any questions. I had heard about the proposal, but I had not heard from its author. We found out the answer by checking the original report. In the end, the team made a decision.

questions.prompt: At nine 与 In the end 分别表达什么？
questions.answer: 前者是时点；后者是最终结果。

questions.prompt: walked into 比 walked to 多了什么信息？
questions.answer: 明确进入房间内部。

questions.prompt: handed out 与 write down 各是什么意思？
questions.answer: 分发；写下。

questions.prompt: heard about 与 heard from 的区别是什么？
questions.answer: 得知某事的消息；收到某人的消息。

questions.prompt: found out 为什么不同于单独的 found？
questions.answer: find out 是查明信息的短语动词。

questions.prompt: made a decision 中为什么不用 did？
questions.answer: make a decision 是惯用搭配。

review.writing: 写 100-120 词记录一次会议或合作任务。
review.check: 至少使用两个时间/地点介词、两个短语动词和一个 do/make/have 搭配。

stages.title: 连接与假设
stages.description: 把简单句组合起来，表达时间、因果、条件和愿望。

review.text: Although the forecast looked bad, we went hiking because we had already booked a guide. We took extra water in case the route was longer than expected. If the weather changed, we would turn back. By noon the sky was clear. I wish I had brought a camera to record the view.

questions.prompt: although 与 because 分别引出什么关系？
questions.answer: 让步；原因。

questions.prompt: in case 为什么不同于 if？
questions.answer: 带水是事先预防，并非路变长后才带。

questions.prompt: longer than 是什么结构？
questions.answer: 比较级结构。

questions.prompt: 能否仅凭 changed 和 would 断定天气最终变了？
questions.answer: 不能。这是从过去视角描述当时的条件性计划，实际结果要看后文。

questions.prompt: By noon 中 by 表示什么？
questions.answer: 到中午这个时点为止。

questions.prompt: I wish I had brought a camera 指现在还是过去的遗憾？
questions.answer: 过去没有带相机的遗憾。

review.writing: 写 100-120 词讲一次计划外变化，解释原因、预防措施和一个事后遗憾。
review.check: 至少用 although/because、in case、一个条件句和 wish+过去完成。

stages.title: 从句与转述
stages.description: 判断从句功能、缺失成分和叙述视角。

review.text: The researcher who led the project wrote a report that many students have read. The report, which was published last month, explains why the results changed. Maya said that the team had checked every figure. When I asked whether she was surprised, she told me to compare the original data with the new chart.

questions.prompt: who led the project 是限定性还是非限定性？
questions.answer: 限定性，说明是哪位研究者。

questions.prompt: which was published last month 为什么用逗号？
questions.answer: 提供关于报告的附加信息，是非限定性从句。

questions.prompt: why the results changed 在句中承担什么作用？
questions.answer: explains 的内容/宾语，采用陈述语序。

questions.prompt: had checked 相对于 said 是先还是后？
questions.answer: 核对数字早于 Maya 说这话。

questions.prompt: whether she was surprised 为什么不倒装？
questions.answer: 这是转述/嵌入的问题。

questions.prompt: told me to compare 中谁执行 compare？
questions.answer: me，即叙述者。

review.writing: 写 100-120 词概述一篇研究文章，并转述作者或同学的评论。
review.check: 至少用一个限定性关系从句、一个非限定性从句、一个名词性内容从句和一个转述句。

stages.title: 高级表达与衔接
stages.description: 学习虚拟式、省略、强调、倒装和篇章组织。

review.text: It is essential that every claim be checked. Our editor has done so for the first section, but the second has not been reviewed yet. It was Maya who noticed the missing source. Never had we seen such a clear correction. On the final page stood a brief note explaining what changed.

questions.prompt: be checked 为什么不写 is checked？
questions.answer: essential that 引出要求型虚拟式，谓语用原形 be。

questions.prompt: done so 替代了什么？
questions.answer: checked every claim。

questions.prompt: the second 指什么？has not been reviewed 是什么形式？
questions.answer: the second section；现在完成时的被动形式。

questions.prompt: It was Maya who... 强调什么？
questions.answer: 强调发现问题的人是 Maya。

questions.prompt: Never had we seen 为什么倒装？
questions.answer: 否定状语 Never 置首，助动词 had 前置。

questions.prompt: On the final page stood a brief note 是什么倒装？
questions.answer: 地点状语置首后的完全倒装，名词主语位于动词后。

review.writing: 写 100-120 词评价一份报告或作品的修订过程。
review.check: 至少用要求型虚拟式、一个替代/省略结构、一个强调结构和一个自然的倒装。

lessons.title: 先看懂句子的骨架
lessons.goal: 先找谓语，再判断谁做什么；不要逐词套中文顺序。
rules: 词类是单词的身份，句子成分是它在本句的工作。名词、代词可以作主语或宾语；形容词描述性质；副词修饰动作、程度或整句；介词带出名词短语；连词连接结构。
先掌握五种常见骨架：S+V；S+V+O；S+系动词+C；S+V+间接宾语+直接宾语；S+V+O+C。S=主语，V=谓语动词，O=宾语，C=补足语。
动词决定后面需要什么：arrive 不直接带宾语；enjoy 通常需要宾语；put 通常还需要地点。修饰语可以很长，先暂时括起来，再找主干。
同一个动词可以有不同句型：The door opened 与 She opened the door 都正确。不要把中文里没有说出的主语、be 或必要介词也一并省掉。
双宾语有搭配限制：give me a book 可改 give a book to me；buy me a book 可改 buy a book for me。但 explain the rule to me 通常不能改 explain me the rule。宾语较长时，把较长的新信息放后面往往更清楚。
examples: The baby slept.
主语+不及物动词：宝宝睡了。
Mia sent her brother a photo.
双宾语：Mia 给弟弟发了一张照片。
We found the room quiet.
宾语+补足语：我们发现房间很安静。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：She put the keys. → She put the keys on the desk. put 在这里还需要交代放在哪里。
quiz: 找出 The students in the back row are reading a report. 的主语中心词和谓语。
students；are reading。in the back row 修饰 students，a report 是宾语。
把“这道题很难”写成完整英文。
This question is difficult. 英语需要系动词 is。

tasks.prompt: 找出 The students in the back row are reading a report. 的主语中心词和谓语。
tasks.answer: students；are reading。in the back row 修饰 students，a report 是宾语。

tasks.prompt: 把“这道题很难”写成完整英文。
tasks.answer: This question is difficult. 英语需要系动词 is。

tasks.prompt: 指出谓语：The manager of the two offices has resigned.
tasks.answer: has resigned；主语中心词是 manager。

tasks.prompt: 选正确句：She explained me the rule. / She explained the rule to me.
tasks.answer: She explained the rule to me. explain 通常不采用双宾语句型。

tasks.prompt: 补足句子：Please put the folder ___.
tasks.answer: 如 on the desk；put 在这里还需地点补语。

tasks.prompt: 判断句型：They elected Maya president.
tasks.answer: S+V+O+C；president 是宾语补足语。

tasks.prompt: 回看例句，解释结构与意义：The baby slept.
tasks.answer: 主语+不及物动词：宝宝睡了。

tasks.prompt: 识别主干：The proposal from our partners changed the schedule.
tasks.answer: 主语中心词 proposal；谓语 changed；宾语 the schedule。

tasks.prompt: 判断句型：The news made everyone nervous.
tasks.answer: S+V+O+C；nervous 说明 everyone 的状态。

tasks.prompt: 改正并说明：She put the keys. → She put the keys on the desk. put 在这里还需要交代放在哪里。
tasks.answer: 错误：She put the keys. → She put the keys on the desk. put 在这里还需要交代放在哪里。

lessons.title: be 与其他系动词
lessons.goal: 区分“是什么、怎么样”和“做什么”。
rules: 现在时用 I am，he/she/it is，you/we/they are；过去时用 I/he/she/it was，you/we/they were。否定直接加 not；疑问把 be 放在主语前。
be 后可接名词、形容词、介词短语：a teacher、happy、at home。不能把表示性质的形容词直接当完整谓语。
seem、appear、look、sound、smell、taste、feel、remain、become、get 可作系动词，后接描述主语的形容词；但有些也能作动作动词，句型与意义随之变化。
seem/appear 可接 to be 或 that 从句。become 较中性或正式，get 常用于变化；go 常见于 go wrong，come 常见于 come true，需连同搭配记忆。
examples: Were you at the library yesterday?
昨天你在图书馆吗？
The soup smells good.
汤闻起来很香。good 描述汤。
He looked carefully at the map.
他仔细看地图。这里 look at 是动作，carefully 修饰动作。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：She seems happily. → She seems happy. 系动词后的 happy 说明她的状态，不是动作方式。
quiz: 填空：The weather ___ cold yesterday, but it ___ warm today.
was；is。时间与主语共同决定 be 的形式。
选择：Your idea sounds good / well.
good。这里 sound 是系动词。

tasks.prompt: 填空：The weather ___ cold yesterday, but it ___ warm today.
tasks.answer: was；is。时间与主语共同决定 be 的形式。

tasks.prompt: 选择：Your idea sounds good / well.
tasks.answer: good。这里 sound 是系动词。

tasks.prompt: 填空：My keys ___ on the table now.
tasks.answer: are。

tasks.prompt: 填空：The room ___ quiet last night.
tasks.answer: was。

tasks.prompt: 选择：The flowers smell sweet / sweetly.
tasks.answer: sweet；smell 在此作系动词。

tasks.prompt: 判断 look 的用法：She looked at the painting carefully.
tasks.answer: 动作动词；carefully 修饰看画的动作。

tasks.prompt: 回看例句，解释结构与意义：Were you at the library yesterday?
tasks.answer: 昨天你在图书馆吗？

tasks.prompt: 比较：The fabric feels soft. 这里 soft 修饰谁？
tasks.answer: soft 描述 fabric；feels 是系动词。

tasks.prompt: 识别 look：Nina looked through the window quietly.
tasks.answer: looked through 是看向窗外的动作；quietly 修饰动作。

tasks.prompt: 改正并说明：She seems happily. → She seems happy. 系动词后的 happy 说明她的状态，不是动作方式。
tasks.answer: 错误：She seems happily. → She seems happy. 系动词后的 happy 说明她的状态，不是动作方式。

lessons.title: 否定句与一般疑问句
lessons.goal: 根据谓语类型选 be、情态动词或 do，不重复标记时态。
rules: 有 be：直接否定或倒装；有情态动词：情态动词后加 not 或移到主语前；完成时的助动词 have 也可这样处理。
一般现在时和一般过去时的普通实义动词需要 do/does/did。加入助动词后，主要动词恢复原形：Does she work?；He did not go。
not 可否定动词，也可否定其他成分，如 not today。no 后直接接名词；nobody、nothing 已有否定意义，标准英语通常不再加另一个否定动词表达同一否定。

lessons.title: 特殊疑问句与嵌入式问句
lessons.goal: 分清疑问词问主语还是宾语；嵌入句使用陈述语序。
rules: 问宾语或状语：疑问词+助动词+主语+动词。问主语时通常不额外使用 do：Who called you? 但强调或否定等特殊语境可以出现 do。
what 范围开放；which 从限定选项中选择；whose 问所属。how old/far/often/long/much/many 各问年龄、距离、频率、时长、数量。
介词可留句末：Who did you speak to? 正式语体可说 To whom did you speak? What is it like? 问特点；What does it look like? 问外观。
I wonder / Do you know / Could you tell me 后的问句内容用“疑问词+主语+谓语”。一般疑问内容用 if/whether。保留整个外层问句的标点。

lessons.title: 祈使句、提议与礼貌请求
lessons.goal: 表达要求时，同时考虑语法和语气。
rules: 祈使句通常省略 you，使用动词原形；否定用 Don't+原形，包括 Don't be late。please 可缓和语气，但并不自动使任何命令都礼貌。
Let's+原形提出共同做某事；否定常用 Let's not...。Let him speak 中的 him 是宾语，后接不带 to 的动词原形。
请求可用 Can/Could/Would you...?；请求允许可用 Can/Could/May I...?。could 常表示礼貌或试探，并不一定指过去。
Would you like+名词/to do...? 邀请或提供；I'd like 表达愿望。Shall I...? 提议自己做，Shall we...? 提议一起做。Would you mind+doing...? 问介不介意。

lessons.title: 简短回应、附加问句与呼应
lessons.goal: 用匹配的助动词避免重复，并听出确认、惊讶和反问。
rules: 简短回答保留与原句一致的 be、助动词或情态动词：Yes, she is；No, they haven't。普通实义动词用 do/does/did。
too 用于肯定补充，either 常用于否定句末。So+助动词+主语表示“也如此”；Neither/Nor+助动词+主语表示“也不”。So I do 则是“确实如此”。
典型附加问句：肯定陈述+否定尾问；否定陈述+肯定尾问。never、hardly、nobody 等使陈述具有否定意义；尾问主语通常用代词。
常见特殊形式：I'm late, aren't I?；Let's go, shall we?；祈使句常接 will you?。升调多为真实确认，降调多期待认同。同向尾问也可表达惊讶、兴趣或挑战，不等于常规确认。
examples: I don't eat meat. Neither does my sister.
我不吃肉，我姐姐也不吃。

你见过 Ben，对吧？

lessons.title: 可数、不可数与单复数
lessons.goal: 先判断具体词义是否可数，再选择冠词、数量词和谓语。
rules: 单数可数名词通常需要限定词：a book、the book、my book。复数通常加 -s/-es；children、people、mice 等需单记。police 常按复数处理，news 通常按单数处理。
不可数名词一般不直接接 a/an、不机械加复数：advice、information、equipment、furniture、research。计数时用 a piece of、an item of 等合适单位。
可数性依意义变化：paper 是材料，a paper 可指论文；chicken 可指肉或一只鸡；experience 可指经验或一次经历。菜单里的 two coffees 指两杯咖啡。
复合名词通常在中心词上变复数：passers-by、mothers-in-law。trousers、scissors 等用 a pair of 计件；a pair of scissors is 中主语中心词是 pair。

lessons.title: a、an、the 的核心选择
lessons.goal: 用“是否单数可数、听者能否识别”决定冠词。
rules: a/an 表示非特定的一个，或介绍新对象、身份：a student。选择看后面紧接的发音，不看首字母：an hour，a university。
the 表示听者能识别具体对象：前文出现过、现场明确、后面限制信息明确，或共享知识中具有唯一性。并非“第二次一定 the”，关键仍是所指是否相同且可识别。
泛指复数和不可数名词常用零冠词：Books matter；Water is essential。特指时仍可用 the：the water in this bottle。
a/an 强调类别中的一个；one 强调数量一、对比或“某一个”：one ticket, not two。a/an 不与 my/this 等限定词叠加；my new bike，不是 the my new bike。
examples: I saw a cyclist. The cyclist was wearing red.

lessons.title: 零冠词、专名与特殊惯例
lessons.goal: 理解泛指和制度性用途，再补充专名习惯。
rules: go to school、be at work、go home、go to bed 常描述常规活动，常不用 the；go to the school 可以指去那所学校建筑。英国英语 in hospital 常指住院，美国英语常用 in the hospital。
语言、学科、一般的三餐和运动通常用零冠词。若加具体限制或描述某一次，可改变：the dinner we had；a wonderful lunch。时间短语有 at night、in the morning 等固定习惯。
多数国家、城市、人名、街道前不加 the；河流、海洋、山脉、群岛以及部分复数或描述性国名前常加 the：the Nile、the Alps、the United States。建筑、机构名称以实际惯用名称为准。
the+形容词可指一类人，如 the elderly，通常配复数谓语。the+单数可数可泛指物种或发明，复数零冠词则更通用。乐器常说 play the piano；季节可用 in (the) summer，特定季节需依语境。

lessons.title: 所属、复合名词与名词短语
lessons.goal: 把核心名词与所有修饰部分分开看。
rules: 人、动物及常见时间组织表达可用 's：Maya's bag、a week's work。以 s 结尾的规则复数后常只加撇号：the students' room；不规则复数用 children's。
of 表示所属、部分等关系：the roof of the house。不是“物品绝不能用 's”：the company's policy 很自然。双重所有格 a friend of mine 指我朋友中的一个。
名词可修饰名词：a coffee cup、a bus stop，前面的名词通常为单数，但有 sports centre 等惯用例外。数字复合修饰语常用单数：a ten-minute break。
两个名词短语可同位解释：Nora, our manager,...；限制身份时不一定加逗号：my colleague Nora。长名词短语先找最后的中心词，再辨别前后修饰及歧义。
examples: This is my parents' apartment.
这是我父母的公寓。

我们需要一个三天的计划。

我的一位老朋友打来了电话。

the children's books。children 已是不规则复数。

lessons.title: 人称、物主与反身代词
lessons.goal: 按句子角色选 I/me/my/mine/myself，不按中文“我”统一替换。
rules: 主格 I/you/he/she/it/we/they 作主语；宾格 me/you/him/her/it/us/them 作动词或介词宾语。介词后用宾格：between you and me。
物主限定词 my/your/his/her/its/our/their 后需要名词；物主代词 mine/yours/his/hers/ours/theirs 可独立使用。its 是所属，it's 是 it is 或 it has。
反身代词用于主语与宾语同指，也可强调本人：She taught herself；I made it myself。by myself 常表示独自或没有帮助；on my own 也可表达独自。
each other/one another 表示相互，不等于 themselves 各自对自己。own 必须结合所属语境：my own room。指性别未知或不愿限定性别的单个人时，they 是常见用法。
examples: This seat is yours; that one is mine.
这个座位是你的，那个是我的。
Leo hurt himself while cooking.
Leo 做饭时伤到了自己。
The two colleagues helped each other.
这两位同事互相帮助。

lessons.title: some、any、no 与不定代词
lessons.goal: 同时判断数量、预期答案和否定范围。
rules: some 常用于肯定句，any 常用于疑问和否定句，但不是机械规则。期待肯定回应的请求或提供可用 some；肯定句中的 any 常表示“任意一个”。
no+名词相当于 not...any；none 可独立使用，none of 指指定集合中没有。回答 Who...? 常用 nobody/no one；回答 How many...? 常用 none。
somebody、anyone、nothing、everywhere 等表达不特指的人、事、地点。everyone/something 等作主语时通常用单数谓语，后文可用 they 呼应未知性别的人。
形容词通常放在这类代词之后：something useful。not everyone 表示并非人人，不是无人；no one 才表示无人。some 可表示“某些但非全部”，也可表示未具体指明的某个人或东西。
examples: Would you like some tea?
要喝点茶吗？提供饮品时自然地用 some。

随便选一个座位。
There is nothing unusual in the report.
报告里没有什么异常的内容。

any。

lessons.title: 数量词：多、少、全部与每个
lessons.goal: 把可数性、范围和说话态度一起考虑。
rules: many/few/a few 修饰可数复数；much/little/a little 修饰不可数。a few/a little 表示有一些；few/little 常强调少得不够。a lot of/lots of/plenty of 可接两类，谓语看后面的名词。
比较数量时可数常用 fewer，不可数用 less；时间、金额、距离等作为整体量时常见 less than。正式写作中说 fewer mistakes，不要机械推广到所有计量表达。
all/most/some+普通名词泛指；指特定集合时可说 most of the students、all (of) my friends，接代词用 of：all of us。most students 不是 the most students。
every+单数强调群体中的每一个；each 强调逐个，也可用于两个；each of+特定复数名词。all day 与 the whole day 都表示整天；every day 是每天，every other day 是隔天。
examples: We have a little time, so let's check again.
还有一点时间，可以再检查。

很少学生选了晚课。
Each of the rooms has a window.
每个房间都有窗户。

lessons.title: both、either、neither 与 one/ones
lessons.goal: 掌握“两者”的数量逻辑，以及名词替代的限制。
rules: both 表示两者都，either 表示两者中的任一个，neither 表示两者都不。both+复数；either/neither+单数；接特定复数集合可用 of：either of the plans。
both...and... 连接并列成分；either...or...、neither...nor... 的两边应结构平行。not both 表示不是两者都，不等于 neither。
one/ones 代替可数名词，避免重复：the red one、the cheaper ones。one 不是不可数名词的一般替代词；替代 water 时常用 some 或 it，依意思决定。
it 指回同一事物，one 指同类中的一个。this/these 通常指较近的单个/多个，that/those 通常指较远的单个/多个，也可按话语距离指代；均可限定名词或独立使用。another 是另一个，the other 常指剩下的另一个；others 是其他一些。
examples: Both routes are safe, but neither is short.
两条路线都安全，但都不短。
My pen is broken. I need a new one.
我要一支同类的新笔，不是原来那支。
I have two bags. One is black; the other is green.
两只包中的一只和另一只。

Neither。强调两个都不住这里。

不是；它只否定“两个都正确”，可能一个对，也可能两个都错。

lessons.title: 主谓一致：先找真正的主语
lessons.goal: 不要让中间的介词短语或复数词误导动词形式。
rules: 谓语通常与主语中心词一致：The list of names is...。each/every/everyone 等通常用单数；时间、金额、距离作为整体可用单数：Ten minutes is enough。
a number of+复数名词配复数，the number of 配单数。all/some/none of 等要看所指名词与意义；none of+复数既可单数也可复数，不能一概判错。
and 通常连接复数主语，但一个整体概念可用单数。either...or/neither...nor 常与较近主语协调；主语人称和数复杂时，改写比生硬套“就近”更清楚。
英国英语 team、government 等集合名词可视整体或成员用单/复数；美国英语一般更倾向单数。the police 通常复数。定语从句的谓语与关系词所指对象一致：one of the students who are...。
examples: The quality of these photos is excellent.

lessons.title: there 与 it：引入信息
lessons.goal: there 介绍存在，it 指代或占位，二者不能随意互换。
rules: there is/are 表示某处存在某人或物；过去用 was/were，完成用 has/have been，将来用 will be。正式书面语中使 be 与后置名词协调。
there 可与 seem、appear、happen 等连用：There seems to be a problem；也可说 there must be。there 本身在存在句里并不表示“在那里”，地点另说。
it 可以指回一个事物，也可用于天气、时间、距离：It's raining；It's five miles。存在新事物用 there；对已知对象说明性质用 it。
形式主语 it 可把较长的不定式或从句放后面：It is useful to take notes。It takes+人+时间+to do 表示耗时。高级形式宾语与强调句在第70课继续。
examples: There is a café nearby. It closes at six.

There have been several changes.

It takes me twenty minutes to walk home.

quiz: 填空：___ will be a meeting tomorrow.
There。引入明天将有的会议。
填空：___ is cold outside.

lessons.title: 动词形式与助动词链
lessons.goal: 先识别原形、过去式、过去分词和 -ing，再学习时态组合。
rules: 英语常见动词形式：work/works/worked/working；不规则动词如 go/went/gone。过去式与过去分词可能相同也可能不同，不能仅凭“过去”二字互换。
第三人称单数常加 -s，部分加 -es，辅音+y 变 -ies。-ed/-ing 有去 e、变 y、双写等规则，详见附录。不能在发音、重音不符合时一概双写。
有限动词承载时态及与主语的关系；后面的形式由前项决定：情态+原形，have+过去分词，be+ing 或 be+过去分词。一般顺序为情态→完成→进行→被动。
先读组合意义再记标签：may have been repaired=可能+已经+被修好。be/have/do 既能作助动词，也能作实义或系动词，不能看见 have 就认定是完成时。
examples: She has written three emails.
has+过去分词 written，构成完成时。
The room is being cleaned.
is+being+cleaned，进行中的被动。
He does his homework after dinner.
这里 does 是实义动词，不是问句助动词。

took；taken；taking。

lessons.title: 一般现在时：规律、状态与叙述
lessons.goal: 不要把“现在”误解为只能描述眼前正在进行的动作。
rules: 一般现在时描述习惯、规律、事实和稳定状态：I walk to work；The shop opens at nine。第三人称单数加 -s；否定、疑问使用 do/does。
know、believe、own 等表示状态时通常不用进行时。think 表观点与 think about 表思考、have 表拥有与 have lunch 表活动，应按具体意义判断。
频率副词 often/usually 等帮助表达习惯，但它们不是决定时态的唯一开关。日程表、时间表也可用一般现在时表示将来，后面还会学习。
高级用法包括体育现场解说、故事梗概、新闻标题及言语行为：I promise...。口语讲故事可在过去叙述中切换现在时制造现场感，正式写作不要无目的地混用。

用现在时概述作品内容。

lessons.title: 现在进行时与一般现在时对比
lessons.goal: 区分常态与暂时过程，并留意动词意义变化。
rules: 现在进行时为 am/is/are+ing，表示此刻或当前阶段正在发展、尚未结束的活动；不要求说话瞬间恰好在做：I'm reading a long novel this month。
一般现在时强调常态，进行时强调临时安排、当前变化：She works in Rome / She is working in Rome this month。时间范围与说话者如何看待事情同样重要。
状态动词通常不用进行时，但某些动词的动作义或临时体验可以：I'm thinking about it；You're being impatient 表示当下表现，不是永久性格。
always/constantly+进行时强调重复行为，常带抱怨，也可赞赏。get、become、change 等的进行时常描述趋势；不要见到 always 就机械排除进行时。
examples: The children are getting taller.
孩子们正在长高。
I live in Chengdu, but I'm staying in Beijing this week.
常住地点与临时停留对比。
She is always offering to help.
她总是主动帮忙，带赞赏语气。

lessons.title: 一般过去时与过去习惯
lessons.goal: 定位已经结束的过去，并把过去习惯与现在进行对比。
rules: 一般过去时描述过去发生并已结束的事件或状态，常和 yesterday、last year、two days ago 等连用。规则动词加 -ed，不规则形式查附录。
否定 did not+原形；疑问 Did+主语+原形。be 的过去时 was/were 自己承担否定或倒装，不再使用 did。
used to+原形描述过去常做或曾经存在的状态，通常暗示现在不再如此。否定、疑问常用 didn't use to / Did...use to...?，规范考试写作优先采用这些形式。
would 可在已建立的过去背景中叙述反复动作，但通常不用于单纯过去状态。used to live 可说；要表达以前住在哪里，不能仅靠 would live 脱离语境替换。
examples: We moved here in 2021.
一次已结束的过去事件。
I used to cycle to school.
以前经常骑车上学，现在情况不同。
Every evening, my grandfather would read to us.
在过去背景中讲反复动作。

lessons.title: 过去进行时与叙事背景
lessons.goal: 区分故事的背景过程与推动情节的事件。
rules: 过去进行时为 was/were+ing，表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，或一段暂时背景。一般过去时则把事件作为整体叙述。
I was cooking when she called 中，做饭是背景，电话是切入事件。不表示电话一定打断或终止了做饭；是否结束要看后文。
while 常引出同时延续的过程，但不是只要有 while 就必须进行时。when 既可引出短事件，也可引出较长时期，应按实际意义选时态。
过去进行时还可表达当时的临时习惯、变化和委婉意图：I was wondering if...。有些状态动词仍以一般过去时更自然。
examples: At eight, I was waiting outside the station.
八点时正在等待。
I was taking notes while she was speaking.
两个过程同时进行。
When I arrived, they ate dinner.
通常表示我到后他们吃饭；换 were eating 则表示到时正在吃。

quiz: 填空：I ___ (read) when the lights went out.
was reading。用进行时提供背景。
The phone rang while we were talking 是否说明我们随后停止说话？
不一定。语法只给出事件与进行中背景的时间关系。

lessons.title: 现在完成时：过去与现在的连接
lessons.goal: 从“到现在为止”或“现在的结果”理解 have/has+过去分词。
rules: 现在完成时形式为 have/has+过去分词。核心不是简单“已经”，而是把过去的事件、经历或持续状态连接到现在的参照点。
可说经历 Have you ever...?，到目前的数量 I've written three pages，当前结果 I've lost my key，持续状态 I've known her for years。语境决定具体含义。
just 常表示刚刚；already 表示已发生，可能早于预期；yet 常在疑问或否定句末表示截至现在；ever/never 常谈经历。不能仅凭关键词机械决定时态。
have been to 表示去过并已返回的经历；have gone to 通常表示去了还未回来。have been in 表示在某地待着。完成时不与明确结束的过去时间直接搭配描述同一事件。
examples: I've finished the draft, so you can read it now.
完成的过去动作带来现在结果。
Have you ever visited Xiamen?
询问截至现在的人生经历。
She has gone to the bank.
她去了银行，此刻通常还未回来。

sent。have/has 后用过去分词。

lessons.title: 完成时与过去时；for、since、ago
lessons.goal: 先确定时间窗口是否延伸到现在，再确定持续多久。
rules: 一般过去时将事件放在结束的过去窗口；现在完成时从现在回看。this morning 在上午尚未结束时可用完成时；下午回看同一上午通常用过去时。
for+时长，since+起点或起点事件，ago 表示从现在往前的过去时点。for 不专属于完成时：I lived there for two years 也可以描述已经结束的居住。
持续到现在的状态常用完成时：How long have you known her?。How long did you live there? 常问已结束的居住；When did you move? 问过去起点。
since 从句常用一般过去时给起点，主句用完成时。It is/has been two years since... 都可见；不是所有中文“了两年”都译成一般现在时或 be+for。
examples: I've lived here for five years.

lessons.title: 现在完成进行时
lessons.goal: 区分持续过程、刚结束的活动痕迹与已完成数量。
rules: 形式为 have/has been+ing，常描述从过去延续到现在的活动，也可描述刚停止但留下当前迹象的活动：You're wet. Have you been running?

examples: I've been waiting for the bus for twenty minutes.
等待已持续二十分钟。
She's written four pages; she's been writing since nine.

Your hands are dirty. Have you been gardening?

lessons.title: 过去完成时与过去完成进行时
lessons.goal: 以过去时点为参照，再回看更早的事件或过程。
rules: 过去完成时为 had+过去分词，表示过去参照点之前已发生的事。参照点可由句子或上下文给出；不是“发生很久以前”就一定用过去完成时。
过去完成进行时为 had been+ing，强调延续到过去参照点的过程或其影响。had written 强调已经写完的内容，had been writing 强调此前写作的过程。
按先后顺序直接叙述的一串事件，通常用一般过去时；需要跳回更早背景、消除时间歧义时才常用过去完成时。before/after 已说明顺序时，有时两种时态均可。
hardly...when / no sooner...than 常描述刚发生一事就发生另一事，前一事件常用过去完成时。未实现的打算可说 had hoped/intended，但语境决定是否后来实现。
examples: When I arrived, the meeting had already started.
我到时，会议此前已经开始。
She was tired because she had been driving for hours.
过去的疲惫来自此前持续开车。
I opened the file, checked the figures and sent it.
按顺序叙述，不必每项都用过去完成时。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：Yesterday I had bought a book. 若只是讲昨天买书，改为 Yesterday I bought a book. 过去完成时需要合理的过去参照。
quiz: 填空：By the time we reached the cinema, the film ___ (begin).
had begun。开始早于到达。
填空：He ___ (wait) for an hour when the office finally opened.
had been waiting。强调此前持续等待。

lessons.title: 表达将来：will、going to 与现在时
lessons.goal: 英语表达将来不只有一种形式，选择取决于打算、证据和安排。
rules: will+原形常用于预测、当场决定、承诺和主动提供帮助；不把 will 简单等同于所有“将要”。going to 常表示已有打算或当前证据支持的预测。
现在进行时可表达已经安排的未来活动，尤其个人约定：I'm meeting Eva tomorrow。一般现在时可表达时间表或固定日程：The train leaves at seven。
will 与 going to 有重叠，不是“计划一定只能 going to”。语境和视角很重要：I think it will rain 是预测；Look at those clouds. It's going to rain 突出眼前证据。
将来时间和条件状语从句通常用现在形式：I'll call when I arrive。若 when 引导的是“何时”的宾语从句，仍可用 will：I don't know when she will arrive。
examples: The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.
当场决定去接。
We're going to repaint the room this weekend.
已有打算。
I'm seeing the dentist at ten tomorrow.
已经安排的预约。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：I'll call you when I will get home. → I'll call you when I get home. 中性的将来时间状语从句不用 will。
quiz: 填空：The museum ___ (open) at nine tomorrow according to the schedule.
opens。按时间表陈述。
“我不知道她什么时候会来”可否用 will？
可以：I don't know when she will come. when 引导宾语内容，不是时间状语。

lessons.title: 将来进行、将来完成及其进行式
lessons.goal: 用未来参照点判断“那时正在”“到那时已完成”“已持续”。
rules: 将来进行时 will be+ing 描述将来某时正在进行的过程，也可表达预期安排：This time tomorrow, I'll be flying to Osaka。
将来完成时 will have+过去分词，表示到某个未来时点已经完成；常用 by、by the time。will have been+ing 强调到未来时点活动已经持续多久。
Will you be using the car tonight? 可较中性地询问安排，而不直接提出请求。未来完成并非必须含有 by，但必须有可理解的未来参照点。
完成与进行依动词意义选择：will have known，不通常说 will have been knowing。所谓将来时态也有推测等语用功能，学习时先掌握时间轴的常规意义。
examples: At this time tomorrow, we'll be taking the exam.
明天此时正在考试。
By Friday, I'll have finished the first draft.
截至周五将已完成。
In June, she'll have been teaching here for ten years.
到六月教学活动将持续满十年。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：By next year, I will live here for ten years. 想强调“到那时已住满十年”，用 will have lived 或 will have been living。

will be working。表示将来某时正在进行。
填空：By noon, we ___ (complete) the checks.
will have completed。表示未来期限前完成。

lessons.title: 其他将来表达与过去将来
lessons.goal: 辨认正式安排、即将发生和从过去看将来的不同视角。
rules: be to+原形常用于正式计划、公告、指令：The panel is to meet on Monday。它也能表示实现某目标的必要前提：If we are to finish, we need help。
be about to、be on the point/verge of doing 表示即将发生；be due to 表示预定；be likely to 表可能；be bound to 表很大把握。about to 通常不与一个遥远的具体未来时间机械搭配。
从过去看将来，常把形式后移：would、was going to、was meeting、was about to。它们本身未必证明事情最终发生，要看后文。
was/were to 在叙事中可回顾后来确实发生的命运或事件；was/were to have done 常用于本来安排而未实现的事。was going to 常谈未实现计划，但也可描述后来实现的计划。
examples: The director is to announce the results tomorrow.
正式安排。
I was about to leave when the call came.
刚要离开时电话来了。
She said she would send the file that evening.
从她说话的过去时点看将来。

quiz: 改写为从过去看将来：I think she will win. → I thought...
I thought she would win.
We were going to meet, but she cancelled. 最后见面了吗？
没有。未实现的信息来自 but she cancelled，不能仅凭 were going to 判断。

lessons.title: 能力、许可与 can/could
lessons.goal: 分清一般能力、一次成功、允许与礼貌请求。
rules: can/could 后用原形，无第三人称 -s。can 表现在能力、允许或一般可能性；could 可表过去能力，也可作现在的礼貌、试探或假设。
过去一般能力可用 could；过去某一次实际成功常用 was/were able to 或 managed to。感知动词、某些认知语境以及否定句中 could 仍常用于具体过去事件。
be able to 可补足 can 没有的形式：will be able to、have been able to。be allowed to 表许可，不等于能力。could have done 常表示本可以、可能曾经等，见第34课。
请求许可用 Can/Could/May I...?；给予许可常回答 You can / You may。can 表一般的潜在可能性，某次不确定是否发生通常用 may/might/could。
examples: I could swim when I was six.
过去一般能力。
After several attempts, we managed to unlock the door.
特定场合实际成功。
Could I use your charger?
现在请求许可，不是过去时间。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：I will can drive soon. → I will be able to drive soon. 两个此类情态动词不能直接叠加。
quiz: 填空：Visitors are not ___ to enter this room.（未经许可）
allowed。
“终于成功找到了出口”优先用 could find 还是 managed to find？
managed to find。明确表示这一次成功。

lessons.title: 可能性与推断：may、might、must、can't
lessons.goal: 区分“有可能”和“根据证据几乎可确定”。
rules: may/might/could+原形表示当前或将来的不确定可能性。三者没有适用于所有语境的固定概率百分比；语气、上下文和说话者态度更重要。
must 表有证据的肯定推断；can't/couldn't 表有证据的否定推断。表示“肯定不是”通常不是 mustn't，后者主要表示禁止。
may not/might not 表可能不；cannot 表不可能、不能或不准，取决于语境。may/might be doing 可推测正在进行的活动。
may well 表“很可能”；may/might as well 表“也不妨”。can 可表示一般常见的可能情形：Winters can be harsh；不能随意用肯定 can 代替特定事件的 may。
examples: The lights are on. Someone must be inside.
根据灯亮推断有人在。
He may be on the train; I'm not sure.
只是可能。
That can't be the final version; it has no references.
根据缺少参考文献作否定推断。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：She mustn't be at home. 若想说“她肯定不在家”，改为 She can't be at home. mustn't 容易变成不准待在家。
quiz: 填空：I haven't decided. I ___ go on Saturday.
may/might/could。表示不确定的计划。
区别 may not come 与 can't come。
前者可能不来；后者视语境表示无法来、不准来或不可能来。

lessons.title: 义务、禁止与没有必要
lessons.goal: mustn't 与 don't have to 的意义完全不同。
rules: must 和 have to 都可表必须。must 常体现说话者提出或认同的要求，have to 常强调情境义务，但这种区别不是硬性二分。过去义务常用 had to。
mustn't 表禁止；don't have to / don't need to / needn't 表不必。must 表推断时的否定另见第30课，不与义务意义混为一谈。
have got to 常见于口语的当前必要性；其他时态通常用 have to 的变化。need 可作普通动词 need to，也可在较正式或英式用法中作情态动词 needn't/Need we...?。
didn't need to do 表过去没有必要，本身不必然说明做没做；needn't have done 明确表示已经做了但没必要。若要明确没做，可加 so I didn't 等语境。
examples: You mustn't share the password.
禁止分享密码。
You don't have to print the form.
不必打印，并不是禁止打印。
I needn't have bought tickets; admission was free.
已经买了票，后来发现没有必要。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：You mustn't come early. 若本意是“不必早来”，改为 You don't have to come early. 前者是不准早来。
quiz: 填空：Yesterday we ___ work until ten.（不得不）
had to。
I didn't need to call her 是否必然表示没打电话？
不必然；只说明没必要。是否实际打了需要上下文。

lessons.title: 建议、预期与 had better
lessons.goal: 区分一般建议、风险警告和“早该做”的语气。
rules: should/ought to 表建议、合乎道理的做法，也可表预期：The parcel should arrive today。ought 后通常有 to，should 后没有。
had better+原形常用于具体情境下较强建议，隐含不这样做可能有问题；否定 had better not。形式里的 had 不表示过去。
It's time to do 表该做了；It's time+主语+过去式常带“早该”的意味，但指现在：It's time we left。
should 可见于 if 从句表示偶然可能，也可用于建议、要求后的 that 从句或表达惊讶；这些高级用法分别见第58、67课。should have done 回顾过去，见第34课。
examples: You should back up your files regularly.
一般建议。
We'd better leave now, or we'll miss the train.
具体风险下较强建议。
It's time we took a break.
现在该休息了，不是在讲过去的休息。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：You had better to check it. → You had better check it. had better 后接原形。
quiz: 填空：You ought ___ tell her the truth.
to。
把“最好不要再等了”写成英文。
We had better not wait any longer. 否定放在 better 后。

tasks.answer: should / ought to。

tasks.answer: not ignore。

tasks.prompt: 区别 You should leave 与 You had better leave 的语气。
tasks.answer: 前者一般建议；后者常暗示不做会有不利后果。

lessons.title: would、偏好与委婉表达
lessons.goal: 同一个 would 可以表达假设、习惯、意愿和礼貌。
rules: would+原形可表假设结果、过去将来、过去反复动作，也可表达礼貌意愿。won't/wouldn't 可表示拒绝或某物不肯正常工作，不总是单纯时间标记。
prefer A to B；prefer doing A to doing B；prefer to do A rather than do B。would prefer 常用于当前具体选择，通常接 to 不定式。
would rather+不带 to 的原形；比较时 rather do A than do B。若后面换主语，常用过去形式表示现在/将来的偏好：I'd rather you stayed。
过去的相反偏好可用 I'd rather you had told me。would like/love/hate/prefer+to do 常用；不要把 like doing 的一般喜好直接机械移到 would like doing。
examples: I'd rather walk than wait for the bus.
宁愿走路，不愿等车。
I'd prefer to discuss this tomorrow.
更愿意明天谈。
The door wouldn't open.
门当时怎么也打不开。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：I'd rather to stay home. → I'd rather stay home. would rather 后不用 to。
quiz: 填空：I prefer tea ___ coffee.
to。
填空：I'd rather you ___ (not smoke) here.
didn't smoke。过去形式表达现在的偏好。

tasks.prompt: 填空：I prefer tea ___ coffee.
tasks.answer: to。

tasks.prompt: 填空：I'd rather you ___ (not smoke) here.
tasks.answer: didn't smoke。过去形式表达现在的偏好。

tasks.prompt: 填空：I would rather ___ (stay) home tonight.
tasks.answer: stay。

tasks.prompt: 填空：She would rather you ___ (call) before visiting.
tasks.answer: called；谈对方目前或将来行为的偏好。

tasks.prompt: 用 would 表过去习惯：我们小时候常在河边玩。
tasks.answer: When we were children, we would play by the river.

tasks.prompt: 区别 I'd prefer to leave 与 I'd rather leave。
tasks.answer: 两者都可表更愿意离开；prefer 后可接 to leave，rather 后用原形 leave。

tasks.prompt: 回看例句，解释结构与意义：I'd rather walk than wait for the bus.
tasks.answer: 宁愿走路，不愿等车。

tasks.prompt: 解释：Would you pass the salt? 这里 would 表什么？
tasks.answer: 礼貌请求，不是过去时间。

tasks.prompt: 表达过去经常做的动作：Every summer we ___ visit our grandparents.
tasks.answer: would / used to；过去反复发生的动作。

tasks.answer: 错误：I'd rather to stay home. → I'd rather stay home. would rather 后不用 to。

lessons.title: 情态动词回看过去
lessons.goal: modal+have+过去分词不等于单一含义，要看是哪种情态。
rules: must have done 表对过去的强推断；can't/couldn't have done 表认为过去不可能；may/might/could have done 可表过去可能发生的事。
could have done 也可表示过去本有机会或能力却没有做，常由上下文确定。不能把所有 could have 都译成“肯定没做”。
should/ought to have done 常表达本该做而未做、遗憾或批评，也可表示预计到现在应已完成。shouldn't have done 常表达做了不该做的事。
needn't have done 表做了但不必要；would have done 常出现在未实现的条件结果中，也可出现在其他推测或转述语境。过去义务一般用 had to，不用 must have done。
examples: She must have left early; her desk is empty.
根据现在证据推断她已早走。
We could have taken a taxi, but we chose to walk.
本可以打车，实际上没打。
You should have checked the address.
批评或遗憾：当时应该核对。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：Yesterday I must have attend a meeting. 若表示昨日必须开会，用 I had to attend a meeting yesterday. 若表示推断，则 must have attended，但意义不同。
quiz: 填空：He can't have ___ (forget); I reminded him twice.
forgotten。
The parcel should have arrived by now 一定是批评吗？
不是。这里可以表示按照预期此刻应该已经送达。

tasks.answer: forgotten。

tasks.prompt: The parcel should have arrived by now 一定是批评吗？
tasks.answer: 不是。这里可以表示按照预期此刻应该已经送达。

tasks.answer: may / might / could。

tasks.prompt: 表达过去本应做但未做：You ___ have checked the address.
tasks.answer: should / ought to。

tasks.prompt: 解释 The package should have arrived by now 的两种语境。
tasks.answer: 可表示按预期此时应已送达，也可在某些语境暗示未达并带失望；不必然是责备。

tasks.prompt: 回看例句，解释结构与意义：She must have left early; her desk is empty.
tasks.answer: 根据现在证据推断她已早走。

tasks.prompt: 表达“他本来可以赶上车”（但没赶上）。
tasks.answer: He could have caught the train. 指过去未实现的可能。

lessons.title: 被动语态的基本结构与选择
lessons.goal: 保持事件意义，改变信息焦点；并非所有动词都能被动化。
rules: 基本形式为 be+过去分词，时态由 be 及其助动词链变化：is made、was made、is being made、has been made、will be made。原宾语可成为被动主语。
当动作承受者更重要、施事未知或无关时使用被动。by 引出施事者，with 常引出工具。主动更清楚时不必为“高级”而改被动。
通常需要可被动化的及物结构。不及物 arrive/happen 等通常没有这种被动；某些动词兼及物与不及物：The door opened 并不是省略 be 的被动。
过去分词也可能表示状态或形容词意义：The door is closed。是否强调动作要看语境；The door is being closed 明确表示关门动作正在发生。
examples: The bridge was built in 1998.
焦点是桥及建造时间。
The documents are being checked.
文件正在接受检查。
Someone has changed the password. / The password has been changed.
同一事件的不同焦点。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：The accident was happened yesterday. → The accident happened yesterday. happen 通常不作此类被动。
quiz: 被动改写：They will announce the results tomorrow.
The results will be announced tomorrow.
填空：The room has been ___ (clean).
cleaned。被动链以过去分词结尾。

tasks.prompt: 被动改写：They will announce the results tomorrow.
tasks.answer: The results will be announced tomorrow.

tasks.prompt: 填空：The room has been ___ (clean).
tasks.answer: cleaned。被动链以过去分词结尾。

tasks.prompt: 被动改写：Someone repaired the lift yesterday.
tasks.answer: The lift was repaired yesterday.

tasks.prompt: 填空：The contract ___ (sign) next week.
tasks.answer: will be signed / is going to be signed。

tasks.prompt: 填空：The documents have been ___ (send).
tasks.answer: sent。

tasks.prompt: 解释 The window broke 为什么不一定是被动语态。
tasks.answer: break 可作不及物动词；没有 be+过去分词。

tasks.prompt: 回看例句，解释结构与意义：The bridge was built in 1998.
tasks.answer: 焦点是桥及建造时间。

tasks.prompt: 改成被动，保留时间：The committee approved the plan yesterday.
tasks.answer: The plan was approved by the committee yesterday. 被动突出 plan。

tasks.prompt: 为何不宜被动：The child slept soundly.
tasks.answer: sleep 在该句中不带宾语，无宾语可提升为被动主语。

tasks.prompt: 改正并说明：The accident was happened yesterday. → The accident happened yesterday. happen 通常不作此类被动。
tasks.answer: 错误：The accident was happened yesterday. → The accident happened yesterday. happen 通常不作此类被动。

lessons.title: 高级被动：转述与非谓语组合
lessons.goal: 掌握信息来源的被动表达，不机械交换每个动词的主宾语。
rules: 转述可用 It is said/believed/reported that...，也可用主语+is said to do。与报告同时的状态用 to be；更早的事件常用 to have done。
被动不定式 to be done、完成被动 to have been done、被动 -ing 形式 being done 可嵌入其他结构。不同动词是否允许这种被动必须看搭配，want/like 等不能任意套“某人被想要去做”。
感官结构可保留 -ing：was seen entering。主动 see/hear/make+宾语+原形，被动中通常恢复 to：was seen to leave；was made to wait。并非所有 let 结构都有对应 be let to。
be supposed to 可表示按规定应该、据说或预定；get+过去分词常见于口语事件性被动，如 got promoted，但不适合替代所有 be 被动。
examples: The building is believed to be over a century old.
据认为这栋楼已有百余年。
He is reported to have left the country.
离开早于当前的报道参照。
She dislikes being interrupted.
被打断的 -ing 被动形式。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：He was made wait outside. → He was made to wait outside. make 的这种被动需要 to。
quiz: 改写：People say that the painting is valuable.
The painting is said to be valuable. 或 It is said that the painting is valuable.
填空：The files need to be ___ (review).
reviewed。被动不定式。

lessons.title: have/get something done 与使役句
lessons.goal: 区分自己做、请人做、让人做与遭遇事件。
rules: have+物+过去分词常表示安排别人完成某事；get+物+过去分词通常较口语，也可强调设法完成。句子不必交代服务提供者。
have+人+原形表示让或安排某人做；get+人+to do 表设法让某人做；make+人+原形带使得或迫使意味；let+人+原形表示允许。
have something done 也可表示不幸遭遇，而非自愿安排：She had her phone stolen。必须结合事件意义判断，不能一律译成“请人”。
have 的时态随主语与时间变化：I'm having my hair cut；We had the roof repaired。不要和现在完成时 have+过去分词混淆，注意中间是否有宾语。
examples: I had my laptop repaired.
我请人修了电脑。
I'll have Leo check the figures.
我会安排 Leo 核对数字。
We got the children to tidy their room.
我们让孩子们收拾了房间。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：I had cut my hair. 若想表达请人理发，用 I had my hair cut. 前者是过去完成时，通常表示我此前剪了头发。
quiz: 填空：She got her brother ___ (help) her.
to help。
He had his wallet stolen 是否表示他安排别人偷钱包？
通常不是；这里描述他遭遇钱包被偷。

tasks.prompt: He had his wallet stolen 是否表示他安排别人偷钱包？
tasks.answer: 通常不是；这里描述他遭遇钱包被偷。

tasks.prompt: 填空：The coach made us ___ (run) again.
tasks.answer: run；主动使役 make+宾语+原形。

tasks.answer: to check。

tasks.answer: 前者通常自己刷；后者安排别人刷，语境另有可能。

tasks.answer: 我请人修了电脑。

tasks.prompt: 区分：I had the door painted. 谁通常刷的门？
tasks.answer: 别人按我的安排刷门；并非必然我亲自刷。

tasks.prompt: 表达“让助手重新安排会议”：I had my assistant ___ the meeting.
tasks.answer: reschedule；have + 人 + 动词原形。

tasks.prompt: 改正并说明：I had cut my hair. 若想表达请人理发，用 I had my hair cut. 前者是过去完成时，通常表示我此前剪了头发。
tasks.answer: 错误：I had cut my hair. 若想表达请人理发，用 I had my hair cut. 前者是过去完成时，通常表示我此前剪了头发。

lessons.title: 动词后接 -ing 还是 to do
lessons.goal: 把“动词+后续句型”作为整体学习，不能只背中文意思。
rules: enjoy、avoid、finish、mind、consider、suggest、admit、deny 常接 -ing；decide、hope、plan、agree、refuse、manage、afford 常接 to 不定式。词义相近不意味着句型相同。
不定式常指向打算、决定或尚待发生的事；-ing 常把活动当作一件事，但这只是帮助理解的倾向，不是万能推导规则。必须记忆具体动词允许的结构。
否定通常放在非谓语前：not going、not to go。完成式 having done/to have done 可表示比主句更早；被动式 being done/to be done 表承受动作。
begin/start/continue 等两种形式常均可，但语境与后续状态动词会影响自然度。先学高频搭配，再处理意义改变的组别，见第39课。
examples: She avoided answering the question.
avoid 后用 -ing。
We decided to take the earlier train.
decide 后用 to do。
He admitted having copied the file.
完成 -ing 强调承认的是此前的行为。

to wait。

opening。mind 后用 -ing。

lessons.title: 形式一变，意思也变
lessons.goal: 重点掌握 remember、stop、try、regret、need 等对照。
rules: remember/forget to do 指记得或忘记履行待做事项；remember doing 指记得做过的经历。regret doing 后悔做过；regret to say/inform 常用于遗憾地宣布坏消息。
stop doing 是停止该活动；stop to do 是停下原活动去做另一件事。go on doing 继续同一活动；go on to do 接着做不同的事。
try to do 是努力设法做到；try doing 是尝试一种方法。mean to do 是打算，mean doing 是意味着。need doing 常有被动意义，等于 need to be done。
like/love/hate 后两种形式常有重叠；doing 常侧重活动体验，to do 也可强调习惯选择或认为适宜的做法。would like 等通常接 to do。help 后可用原形或 to do；can't help doing 是忍不住。
examples: I remembered to lock the door.
我记得去锁门并做了。
I remember locking the door.
我记得曾锁门这个经历。

lessons.goal: 先保住动词与必要宾语，再安排修饰信息。
rules: 普通方式副词通常不插在及物动词与直接宾语之间：read the letter carefully。时间和地点状语较灵活；中性句末常地点先于时间，重要或较长的信息可后移。

lessons.title: 比较级、最高级与比较结构
lessons.goal: 比较对象与结构必须对应；不要重复使用 more 和 -er。
rules: 较短形容词常加 -er/-est，较长词常用 more/most；good/well→better/best，bad→worse/worst，far 可用 farther/further，意义和搭配略有区别。
比较级+than；as+原级+as 表同等；not as/so...as 表不及。正式比较代词可补出谓语：than I am；口语 than me 很常见，不要一概视为错误。
最高级常带 the，尤其在名词前；物主限定词可替代 the：my best friend。两者之间传统上用比较级，较大集合用最高级。one of the best+复数名词。
much/far/a lot/even/slightly/a little 可修饰比较级。more and more、bigger and bigger 表越来越；the more..., the more... 表越……越……。比较从句可省略重复内容，但必须意思清楚。

much 修饰比较级。

The more you practise, the more confident you become.

lessons.title: so、such、too、enough 与程度焦点
lessons.goal: 表达程度时留意后面接形容词、名词还是结果结构。
rules: so+形容词/副词；such+(a/an)+形容词+名词。可接 that 结果从句。数量表达用 so many/much/few/little；little 意为“小”时又可用 such a little room。
too 表超出合适程度，常带负面或无法实现的结果；very 只是程度高。形容词/副词+enough，enough+名词；可接 for someone to do。
quite、rather、fairly、pretty 表程度，但强弱与语调、英美用法和形容词意义有关。quite good 在英式语境可较保留；quite impossible 常表示完全不可能。
even 突出出乎意料，even if 引出假设，even though 引出承认的事实；not even 表连……都不。rather/quite 与 a/an 位置有不同惯例：quite a good idea、a rather difficult task。
examples: It was such a useful lesson that I took extra notes.
such 修饰名词短语。
The bag is too heavy for me to carry.
重到超出我的承受能力。
We have enough time, but the room isn't quiet enough.
enough 放在名词前、形容词后。

lessons.title: 时间介词：时点、时段与期限
lessons.goal: 先判断问的是“何时、多久、从何时到何时还是截止时间”。
rules: at 常接钟点、noon/night；on 常接日期和具体某天：on Monday morning；in 常接月、年、季节和一般 morning/afternoon/evening。next/last/this/every 后的时间词常不再加介词。
for+时长，since+起点；from...to/until... 表起止。during+名词说明某时段内，while+从句说明同时发生；in 也可用于某时段内，语境决定选择。
by 指最迟期限，until/till 指持续到某时；before 指在某时之前。by the time+从句经常结合完成形式。on time 是按时，in time 是及时赶得上。
at the end of 指某段时间或事物的末尾；in the end 指最终结果。in ten minutes 常表示十分钟后，也可在其他语境表示完成耗时；within ten minutes 强调不超过十分钟。
examples: The meeting starts at nine on Tuesday.

lessons.title: 地点、方向与 between/among
lessons.goal: 把位置关系、运动目的地和穿越路径分开表达。
rules: in 强调空间内部或较大区域，on 强调表面/线路，at 强调一个点、活动地点或功能位置。in a building 与 at a building 可因视角不同而同时成立。
to 表目的地，into 表进入内部，onto 表到表面；arrive in+城市/国家，arrive at+较具体地点；reach 通常直接带宾语。home/here/there 作方向副词时不再加 to。

lessons.goal: 不要只把介词译成一个中文词，要看它构成什么关系。
rules: by 可表施事、方法、交通：by train、by email；on foot 是固定表达。具体某辆交通工具常用 on the bus、in a taxi。with 常指工具或随带，without 表没有。

lessons.goal: 先判断小品词能否拆分，再确定代词的位置。

不及物短语如 wake up 可没有宾语。介词动词如 look after 后的宾语通常不能搬到中间：look after them。三词结构如 look forward to、put up with 也要整体掌握。
in/out 常涉及进入、退出、出现或分发：fill in a form、check in、find out、work out、hand out、run out of。in/out 不是固定一个中文意义。
on/off 常涉及继续、启动、关闭或离开：carry on、try on、put on、take off、set off、put off。语义可转移：put off a meeting 是推迟，而不是字面“放离”。

lessons.title: up/down/away/back 与高频轻动词
lessons.goal: 按场景记短语，同时区分 do、make、have、get、go。
rules: up 可表升起、完成、增加或开始：pick up、give up、set up、use up；down 可表降低、写下、坏掉：turn down、write down、break down。语义不能只靠方向猜。
away/back 可表移走、离去、返还或回应：throw away、go away、give back、call back、pay back。可分性仍按具体短语判断，尤其代词宾语。
do 常与工作、任务、活动搭配：do homework/research；make 常与产物、决定、影响搭配：make a decision/mistake/noise。have 可表吃、体验、动作：have lunch/a shower/a look，不一定表示拥有。
get 可表得到、收到、到达、变得，也有 get+宾语+补足语；go 可接目的地、活动或变化：go to work、go on holiday、go for a walk、go swimming、go wrong。have got 表拥有，不要与所有动作 have 混用。

lessons.title: 并列句与原因从句
lessons.goal: 先区分连接完整句子还是连接句内成分。
rules: and、but、or、so 可连接相应成分或分句；两边应结构平行。两个独立句不能仅靠一个逗号拼接，需用连词、分号或句号组织。
because 引出原因从句，because of 后接名词或 -ing；since/as 也可给原因，常把原因作为背景，而 because 更直接回答 why。since 同时可表示从……以来，注意消歧。
英语通常不在同一主从结构中照搬中文“因为……所以……”为 because...so...；although...but... 也同理。可用其中一种关系结构。
for 作解释性连词通常较正式，引出补充推断理由；with+名词短语可提供背景原因。however/therefore 是连接性副词，不是能随意替代 but/so 的并列连词，见第72课。
examples: I stayed home because the road was closed.
because 后接完整从句。
The match was cancelled because of the rain.
because of 后接名词。
She checked the figures and corrected the errors.
两个动词短语结构平行。

lessons.title: 时间从句与预防性的 in case
lessons.goal: 厘清先后、持续、同时和提前防备的关系。
rules: when、while、as、before、after、until、since、as soon as、once 等引出时间关系。while/as 常描写同步过程，when 用法更宽，不必机械绑定某一种时态。
谈将来的时间状语从句，通常用现在时；强调先完成可用现在完成时：I'll send it after I've checked it。主句不一定用 will，也可用祈使或情态结构。
until 表持续到；not...until 表直到才；by the time 说明到某时为止的参照。before 可表示后一个动作尚未发生，after/once 突出先决完成。
in case 表提前预防可能情况：Take a coat in case it gets cold，与 if 不同，通常是现在先带。in case of+名词意为遇到某情况。just in case 可独立作补充。
examples: I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
抵达后立即联系。
Wait here until the lights turn green.
等待持续到灯变绿。
Take a charger in case your battery runs low.
先带充电器以防电量不足。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：Take water in case you will get thirsty. → Take water in case you get thirsty. 中性将来预防情境用现在形式。
quiz: 填空：I'll return the book when I ___ (finish) it.
have finished 或 finish；前者更突出先读完。
区别 I'll call if I need help 与 I'll take your number in case I need help。
前者需要时才打；后者现在先留号码以备将来需要。

lessons.title: 目的、结果、让步与比较连接
lessons.goal: 相近中文连接词背后可能要求不同的语法结构。
rules: 目的可用 to/in order to/so as to+原形；否定用 in order not to/so as not to。so that/in order that+从句可明确不同主语。for+名词说明用途，for doing 常描述功能，不直接替代所有目的 to do。
结果用 so+形容词/副词+that 或 such+名词短语+that。too...to、enough to 也能表达程度与结果关系。so that 还可表结果，须结合语境。
although/though/even though 接从句；despite/in spite of 接名词或 -ing，可接 the fact that+从句。even if 引出假设让步，even though 常承认事实；whereas/while 常对比两种情况。
like+名词常表相似，as 可表示身份或接从句表达方式；口语 like 作连词也常见。as if/as though 表好像，可用普通时态表达可能真实，也可用过去形式拉开现实距离。
examples: I wrote it down so that I wouldn't forget.
目的从句说明记下的目的。
Although it was raining, we went out.
从句让步。
She spoke as if she knew everyone there.

lessons.title: 真实条件、unless 与条件变体
lessons.goal: 表达规律、开放的未来条件和必要前提。
rules: 一般规律常用 if+一般现在时，主句也用现在时；开放未来条件常用 if+现在时，主句可用 will、can、may 或祈使句。不要把真实条件误当必然会实现。
unless 常表示 if...not，即“除非”。但若它造成因果或例外逻辑改变，不能逐字替换。unless 从句通常不再加重复否定，除非语义确实需要。
as/so long as、provided/providing (that)、on condition that 表条件；only if 强调必要条件，if only 则常表愿望，见第60课。
if 后的 will/would 有时可表愿意、坚持或礼貌，而非普通将来；if...should 可表偶然可能。if...be to 可讨论实现目标所需条件。先掌握常规，再按意义识别这些例外。
examples: If you heat ice, it melts.
一般规律。
If it rains, we'll move the event indoors.
开放的未来条件。
You can borrow it as long as you return it tomorrow.
附带归还条件。

lessons.title: 非真实条件与混合时间
lessons.goal: 过去形式也能表示心理距离，不一定表示过去时间。
rules: 对现在或将来不真实、较不可能的假设：if+过去形式，主句 would/could/might+原形。be 可用 were 表正式假设，口语非正式也常见 was。
对过去未实现情形的假设：if+had+过去分词，主句 would/could/might have+过去分词。不能把主句的 would have 机械放进常规 if 从句。
混合条件按真实时间关系组合：过去原因、现在结果用 If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now；现在持续特征、过去结果也可能组合。
were to 表较假设性的将来；without/but for、otherwise、or 等可含条件意义。非真实结构不总表示逻辑上绝无可能，程度取决于语境与说话者看法。
examples: If I had more time, I would take another course.
假设现在有更多时间。
If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.
回顾过去未实现的条件与结果。
If I hadn't missed the bus, I would be home now.
过去事件影响现在状态。

lessons.title: wish、if only 与其他假设表达
lessons.goal: 区分希望未来发生、遗憾当前状况与后悔过去。
rules: wish/if only+过去形式常表示对现在状况的遗憾；+had done 表示对过去的遗憾；+could 表达能力或机会上的愿望。if only 往往感情更强。
wish+would 常表达希望别人或外部情况改变、对反复行为不满。通常不用于单纯表达自己能自主决定的愿望，也不随意代替所有 wish+过去式。
hope 表开放的希望：I hope you pass；wish you luck 是名词结构。I wish you passed 不是一般“祝你考试通过”的中性表达。
would rather+他人主语+过去形式、it's time+过去形式、suppose/supposing/imagine+假设从句、as if/as though+过去形式，都可借过去形式拉开现实距离。正式假设常用 were。
examples: I wish I knew the answer.
遗憾现在不知道。
If only I had checked the date.
后悔过去没核对日期。
I wish they would turn the music down.
希望他们改变正在令人不满的行为。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：I wish I will have more time. 若遗憾现在没时间，用 I wish I had more time；若希望未来有时间，用 I hope I'll have more time。
quiz: 填空：I wish I ___ (not send) that message yesterday.
hadn't sent。
“希望你明天旅途顺利”用 hope 写一句。
I hope you have a good journey tomorrow. 也可说 I hope your journey goes well tomorrow。

lessons.title: 限定性关系从句
lessons.goal: 找先行词，再看关系词在从句里缺哪个位置。
rules: 限定性关系从句帮助识别“哪一个”，通常不加逗号。人用 who/that，物常用 which/that；正式宾语人称可用 whom。不能按“人或物”判断完就停止，还要看从句结构。
关系词作主语通常不可省：the person who called。作宾语时在限定性从句中常可省：the book (that) I bought。不要在从句中重复主语或宾语。
whose+名词表示所属，可用于人，也可用于事物，尤其正式写作。where/when/why 分别引出地点、时间、原因关系，只有从句确实需要相应状语时才用。
what 常自带“所……的事物”意义，没有另外的先行词：what I need。the thing that I need 可以；the thing what I need 不是规范通用结构。
examples: The woman who teaches this class is from Canada.
who 在从句里作主语。
The article I sent you explains the issue.
关系词作 sent 的宾语，可省略。
This is the café where we met.
where 相当于合适语境中的 in/at which。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：The book that I bought it is useful. → The book that I bought is useful. that 已对应宾语，不再重复 it。
quiz: 能否省略 who：The student who won the prize is here.
不能。who 是 won 的主语。
填空：This is the town ___ I visited last year.
which/that，或省略；visited 缺宾语，不用 where。

tasks.answer: 不能。who 是 won 的主语。

tasks.prompt: 填空：This is the town ___ I visited last year.
tasks.answer: which/that，或省略；visited 缺宾语，不用 where。

tasks.prompt: 填空：The student ___ won the prize is here.
tasks.answer: who / that；作从句主语，不可省。

tasks.answer: who 在从句里作主语。

tasks.prompt: 判断可否省略关系词：The scientist who won the prize is here.
tasks.answer: 不能；who 是关系从句的主语。

tasks.prompt: 补关系词：The article ___ you recommended was useful.
tasks.answer: that / which / 省略均可；关系词作宾语。

deepPractice.prompt: 省略关系词：The folder that Maya bought is blue.
deepPractice.answer: 可省略 that；关系词是 bought 的宾语。

lessons.title: 非限定、介词关系词与高级关系结构
lessons.goal: 标点、介词和关系词共同决定结构及信息范围。
rules: 非限定性从句提供附加信息，通常以逗号隔开；用 who/whom/which/whose，不用 that，关系词也不能像限定性宾语关系词那样直接省掉。
介词可留句末，正式写作可前置：the person to whom I spoke；the method by which...。前置介词后通常不用 that，也不能省关系词；whose+noun 前同样可有介词。
which 可指前面整件事：She passed, which surprised us。数量结构可用 some/many/none of whom/which，引出对集合的补充说明。
when/where/why 与具体介词+which 的对应由意义决定；whereby 常表示借以或通过某机制，较正式。抽象 situation/case 等后可用 where 表关系场景。
examples: My laptop, which I bought last year, still works well.
附加说明，不用来筛选哪台电脑。
We met six researchers, two of whom work abroad.
对六人中的两人补充说明。
They created a system whereby users can report errors.
whereby 表通过该机制。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：Mia, that lives next door, is a doctor. → Mia, who lives next door, is a doctor. 非限定性从句不用 that。
quiz: 用前置介词改写：the colleague who I work with。
the colleague with whom I work。
填空：He missed the deadline, ___ caused a delay.
which。指错过截止日期这件事。

tasks.prompt: 用前置介词改写：the colleague who I work with。
tasks.answer: the colleague with whom I work。

tasks.prompt: 填空：He missed the deadline, ___ caused a delay.
tasks.answer: which。指错过截止日期这件事。

tasks.prompt: 填空：Maya, ___ works next door, is an architect.
tasks.answer: who；非限定从句不用 that。

tasks.prompt: 改写为正式前置介词：the person who I spoke to
tasks.answer: the person to whom I spoke

tasks.prompt: 填空：We met five artists, two of ___ live here.
tasks.answer: whom。

tasks.prompt: 解释 She passed the exam, which surprised us 中 which 指什么。
tasks.answer: 指前面整件“她通过考试”的事。

tasks.prompt: 回看例句，解释结构与意义：My laptop, which I bought last year, still works well.
tasks.answer: 附加说明，不用来筛选哪台电脑。

tasks.prompt: 判断意义：My sister, who lives in Leeds, is visiting. 从句可否当作挑选哪位姐姐的必要信息？
tasks.answer: 通常不能；逗号提示非限定补充信息。

tasks.prompt: 填关系词：The candidate to ___ I spoke has withdrawn.（正式语体）
tasks.answer: whom；介词前置时正式用 whom。

tasks.prompt: 改正并说明：Mia, that lives next door, is a doctor. → Mia, who lives next door, is a doctor. 非限定性从句不用 that。
tasks.answer: 错误：Mia, that lives next door, is a doctor. → Mia, who lives next door, is a doctor. 非限定性从句不用 that。

deepPractice.prompt: 判断逗号影响：My colleagues who work remotely joined online.
deepPractice.answer: 限定性：只说远程工作的同事；未必全部同事。

deepPractice.prompt: 判断逗号影响：My colleagues, who work remotely, joined online.
deepPractice.answer: 非限定性：把远程工作作为对同事的补充信息。

deepPractice.prompt: 正式改写：The researcher who I spoke to responded.
deepPractice.answer: The researcher to whom I spoke responded. 介词前置时用 whom。

lessons.title: 缩减关系从句、同位语与长名词短语
lessons.goal: 压缩修饰语之前，确保主被动、时间和指向清楚。
rules: 名词后的 -ing 可表主动过程或特征：students waiting outside；过去分词常表被动：documents sent yesterday。being+过去分词突出被动过程，不能把所有关系从句一概删词缩减。
to 不定式可修饰名词：the first person to arrive、work to do、a room to stay in。具体是执行者、承受者还是地点，要检查句中逻辑与必要介词。
同位名词短语补充身份：Lin, the team leader,...；限制性命名不一定加逗号。namely、that is 可作解释补充；多个同位身份应避免误读为多个人。
介词短语与从句可层层修饰名词，但应就近明确连接。the report on accidents in factories 可能有修饰歧义，改写能比继续堆叠更多短语更清楚。
examples: The people waiting outside have appointments.
相当于适合语境中的 who are waiting。
The files uploaded yesterday are incomplete.
uploaded 表被动修饰。
Eva, our new editor, will review the draft.
同位名词解释 Eva 的身份。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：The students finished the test may leave. 若想作名词后置修饰，改为 The students who have finished the test may leave. 不能任意删掉关系词和 have。
quiz: 缩减：the report that was published yesterday。
the report published yesterday。
填空：I need a quiet place to work ___.
in，按这里 place 作为工作地点的结构保留介词；也可另写 somewhere quiet to work。

tasks.prompt: 缩减：the report that was published yesterday。
tasks.answer: the report published yesterday。

tasks.prompt: 填空：I need a quiet place to work ___.
tasks.answer: in，按这里 place 作为工作地点的结构保留介词；也可另写 somewhere quiet to work。

tasks.prompt: 缩减：the files that were sent yesterday
tasks.answer: the files sent yesterday

tasks.prompt: 缩减：the woman who is standing by the window
tasks.answer: the woman standing by the window

tasks.prompt: 填空：I have no one to talk ___.
tasks.answer: to；保留介词。

tasks.prompt: 回看例句，解释结构与意义：The people waiting outside have appointments.
tasks.answer: 相当于适合语境中的 who are waiting。

tasks.answer: 错误：The students finished the test may leave. 若想作名词后置修饰，改为 The students who have finished the test may leave. 不能任意删掉关系词和 have。

deepPractice.answer: The engineers working overnight will report tomorrow. 主动的进行性修饰。

deepPractice.prompt: 诊断：The report writing by Sara is ready.
deepPractice.answer: The report written by Sara is ready. report 是被写的。

lessons.title: that、wh、whether 与名词性内容
lessons.goal: 区分“陈述一个内容”和“提出一个问题”，从句内部不倒装。
rules: that 从句可作动词、形容词或名词的内容补语，也可作主语。常见动词宾语中的 that 有时可省；句首主语从句或需要避免歧义时通常保留。
wh 从句包含具体问题或所指内容：I know where she lives；What she said matters。what 可整体表示“所说的话”，不要先加一个重复的名词先行词。
whether/if 可引出“是否”的间接问题；whether 在介词后、to 不定式前或句首主语从句中通常更合适/必要。whether or not 可连用，if 不宜机械套同样位置。
疑问词+to do 常表示该如何、何时、做什么：how to apply。并非所有疑问词都自然地构成这种结构，why 后通常不能照搬 why to do。名词后的 that 内容从句不等于定语从句。
examples: Whether we can finish depends on the data.
是否能完成作为整体主语。
I don't know what to say.
不知道该说什么。
The fact that she left early surprised us.
that 从句说明 fact 的内容，内部并不缺成分。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：It depends on if he agrees. → It depends on whether he agrees. 介词后通常用 whether。
quiz: 填空：We haven't decided ___ to stay or leave.
whether。
区分 the claim that he made 与 the claim that he was innocent。
前者是限定性关系从句，made 缺宾语；后者是内容从句，说明声明的内容。

tasks.prompt: 填空：We haven't decided ___ to stay or leave.
tasks.answer: whether。

tasks.prompt: 区分 the claim that he made 与 the claim that he was innocent。
tasks.answer: 前者是限定性关系从句，made 缺宾语；后者是内容从句，说明声明的内容。

tasks.prompt: 填空：I do not know ___ she will agree.（是否）
tasks.answer: whether / if。

tasks.prompt: 改错：I wonder where is he.
tasks.answer: I wonder where he is.

tasks.prompt: 区别 the news that she left 与 the news that she reported。
tasks.answer: 前者 that 引出新闻内容；后者 that 是关系词，指她报道的新闻。

tasks.prompt: 填空：___ he refused is unclear.（他为什么拒绝）
tasks.answer: Why。

tasks.prompt: 回看例句，解释结构与意义：Whether we can finish depends on the data.
tasks.answer: 是否能完成作为整体主语。

tasks.prompt: 填 that/whether：We need to know ___ the road is open.
tasks.answer: whether / if；内容是一个未决问题。

tasks.prompt: 填 that/whether：The claim ___ the road is open may be false.
tasks.answer: that；介绍 claim 的陈述内容。

tasks.prompt: 改正并说明：It depends on if he agrees. → It depends on whether he agrees. 介词后通常用 whether。
tasks.answer: 错误：It depends on if he agrees. → It depends on whether he agrees. 介词后通常用 whether。

deepPractice.prompt: 填连接词：I do not know ___ the figures are final.
deepPractice.answer: whether / if；尚待回答的问题。

deepPractice.answer: that；belief 的陈述内容。

deepPractice.answer: We discussed whether the figures were final. discuss 在这里直接带宾语。

lessons.title: 转述陈述：视角、时态与指代
lessons.goal: 转述的是意义与时间关系，不是把每个词机械向后挪。
rules: say 后可接内容，tell 通常需说明告诉谁：said that...；told me that...；say to me 也可。转述改变人称、时间和地点指向，依转述现场而定。
过去报告动词之后，时态常后移：is→was，did/has done→had done，will→would。过去完成时通常不再后移；已经表达假设的过去形式也不能盲目再改。
若内容仍真实、仍相关或转述者认可，可能不后移：She said she lives nearby。报告动词现在时也常保留原时间关系，不能用一条公式覆盖全部。
today/now/here/this 等只有在参照改变时才改为 that day/then/there/that；并不是见到 reported speech 就必须换。间接转述通常不用原话引号。
examples: “I'm tired,” she said. → She said that she was tired.
从过去的说话时点转述。
Leo told me that he had already sent the file.
发送早于他告诉我的时刻。
She said the museum opens at nine.
仍适用的时间表可以保留现在时。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：He said me that he was busy. → He told me that he was busy. 或 He said to me that he was busy.。
quiz: 在次日转述：“I will call you tomorrow,” Mia said to me.
Mia told me that she would call me the next day. 人称和时间按题设调整。
She said she is a doctor 一定错吗？
不一定。若职业现在仍成立并作为当前事实转述，可以不后移。

tasks.prompt: 在次日转述：“I will call you tomorrow,” Mia said to me.
tasks.answer: Mia told me that she would call me the next day. 人称和时间按题设调整。

tasks.prompt: She said she is a doctor 一定错吗？
tasks.answer: 不一定。若职业现在仍成立并作为当前事实转述，可以不后移。

tasks.prompt: 次日转述：Mia said, “I am tired.”
tasks.answer: Mia said that she was tired. 若状态仍持续，在合适语境也可保留 is。

tasks.prompt: 次日转述：He said, “I saw her yesterday.”
tasks.answer: He said he had seen her the day before. 视角确定时也可能保留 saw，需看叙述时间。

tasks.prompt: 解释 She said the Earth is round 为什么可保留 is。
tasks.answer: 普遍事实仍成立，不必机械回移。

tasks.prompt: 把 She said, “This is my book.” 从旁观者视角转述。
tasks.answer: She said that was her book. this/that 取决于说话人所在位置。

tasks.prompt: 回看例句，解释结构与意义：“I'm tired,” she said. → She said that she was tired.
tasks.answer: 从过去的说话时点转述。

tasks.prompt: 转述：Anna said, “I am busy today.”（当天转述，仍然忙）
tasks.answer: Anna said (that) she is busy today. 视角改为 she；若仍属实，不必机械回移时态。

tasks.prompt: 转述：Mark said, “I left yesterday.”（次日转述）
tasks.answer: Mark said that he had left the day before. 时间和人称随转述视角变化。

tasks.prompt: 改正并说明：He said me that he was busy. → He told me that he was busy. 或 He said to me that he was busy.。
tasks.answer: 错误：He said me that he was busy. → He told me that he was busy. 或 He said to me that he was busy.。

lessons.title: 转述问题、请求、建议与情态意义
lessons.goal: 依据说话行为选择报告动词和补语句型。
rules: 转述问题用 asked/wondered+疑问词或 if/whether，后面为陈述语序，不保留问句的 do 倒装。是否加问号取决于最外层句子，而不是里面曾经是个问题。
请求、命令、提醒常用 ask/tell/order/remind+人+to do；否定 not to do。提议自己做用 offer to do，承诺 promise to do；不能所有动词都加一个人作宾语。
建议可用 suggest/recommend doing 或 suggest that...；通常不能说 suggest someone to do。advise someone to do 与 advise doing 均常见，结构不同。
情态转述常 can→could、will→would、may→might；should/could/might/would 常保留。must 的义务意义可转 had to，推断意义常保留 must；持续要求也可保留，按意义决定。
examples: She asked where I worked.
间接问题不用 where did I work。
He reminded me not to share the link.
提醒的否定不定式。
Mia offered to carry the box.
主动提出由 Mia 搬。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：She suggested me to rest. → She suggested that I rest / She suggested resting. 若用 advise，则 She advised me to rest.。
quiz: 转述：The teacher said to us, “Don't open the file.”
The teacher told us not to open the file.
转述：She asked me, “Have you finished?”
She asked me if/whether I had finished. 在典型过去转述中后移时态。

tasks.prompt: 转述：The teacher said to us, “Don't open the file.”
tasks.answer: The teacher told us not to open the file.

tasks.prompt: 转述：She asked me, “Have you finished?”
tasks.answer: She asked me if/whether I had finished. 在典型过去转述中后移时态。

tasks.prompt: 转述：He asked me, “Where do you live?”
tasks.answer: He asked where I lived. 若仍住在那里，也可在适当语境保留 live。

tasks.prompt: 转述：She said to me, “Please wait.”
tasks.answer: She asked me to wait.

tasks.prompt: 改错：He suggested me to leave.
tasks.answer: He suggested that I leave. / He suggested leaving.

tasks.prompt: 转述：The teacher said to us, “Do not touch it.”
tasks.answer: The teacher told us not to touch it.

tasks.prompt: 回看例句，解释结构与意义：She asked where I worked.
tasks.answer: 间接问题不用 where did I work。

tasks.prompt: 转述提问：She asked, “Where are the keys?”
tasks.answer: She asked where the keys were. 转述问句用陈述语序。

tasks.prompt: 转述请求：He said, “Please wait outside.”
tasks.answer: He asked us to wait outside. 可按实际受话人替换 us。

tasks.prompt: 改正并说明：She suggested me to rest. → She suggested that I rest / She suggested resting. 若用 advise，则 She advised me to rest.。
tasks.answer: 错误：She suggested me to rest. → She suggested that I rest / She suggested resting. 若用 advise，则 She advised me to rest.。

lessons.title: 名词化转述与要求型虚拟式
lessons.goal: 辨认“事实陈述”和“要求某事实现”的区别。
rules: 转述不必总用 say：the claim/announcement/suggestion that... 可用名词概括；the decision to do、the question of whether...、instructions on how to... 是其他内容结构。
形容词也可报告态度或把握：certain that、unsure whether、critical of、apologetic about。把原话改为名词化内容时，应保留来源、把握程度和说话者立场。
要求、建议、必要性后的 that 从句可用动词原形，即要求型现在虚拟式：They recommended that she apply；It is essential that he be informed。否定直接 not+原形，不加 does。
尤其英式语境可用 should+原形。suggest 表“暗示事实”、insist 表“坚持说事实”时不自动使用要求型虚拟式。表达惊讶反应的 should 又是另一用法，不等于要求对方做事。
examples: They demanded that the fee be refunded.
要求退款，be 不随主语或报告时态变形。
The evidence suggests that he is right.
证据暗示事实，正常陈述时态。
She rejected the claim that the data were unreliable.
用 claim 概括被转述观点。

be；也可用 should be。

lessons.title: so、not、do so 与替代结构
lessons.goal: 避免重复时，明确替代的是整句还是某个动作。
rules: I think/believe/suppose/expect/hope so 中，so 替代前述命题。否定常用 I don't think so；hope/assume 等也可用 not：I hope not。搭配不同，不能任意说所有动词+so。
if so/if not 表若如此/若非如此；so it seems 表看来如此。so+助动词+主语表示也一样，与命题替代不是同一种结构。
do so 常替代前面可理解的动作或活动，在正式书面语较常见；并非所有静态关系都适合。do it/that 往往更直接指某项行动，可能带强调或对照。
such 可表示此类/如此的；such a+单数名词、such+复数/不可数。代替名词的 one/ones 与代替整个命题的 so 要分清。
examples: “Will the shop be open?” “I think so.”
so 代替商店将开门这一内容。
“Will it rain?” “I hope not.”
希望不会下雨。
Please check the figures if you haven't already done so.
done so 代替核对数字这个动作。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：I know so. 在普通回应“我知道是这样”时，多说 I know / I know that，而不是把 think so 的句型推广到 know。
quiz: 简短回应：Do you think she will agree?（我想不会）
I don't think so.
改写避免重复：He promised to call, but he never called.
He promised to call, but he never did so. 也可简洁说 never did。

lessons.title: 省略助动词后的内容与 to 不定式
lessons.goal: 省略的是可从上下文恢复的信息，不是随意删词。
rules: 前文已有动作时可保留助动词：She has finished, but I haven't。没有助动词的普通实义动词用 do/does/did；主要动词是 be 时通常保留 be。
有多个助动词时可保留第一个，必要时保留更多以清楚表达：They might have been delayed, and we might (have been) too。省略后仍须保持时态和主语关系。
want/hope/choose/be able 等后的重复不定式常只保留 to：I'd love to；I chose not to。若省略的主要内容是 be，通常保留 to be：He wasn't ready, but pretended to be。
某些动词或形容词后连 to 也可在足够明确的语境中省掉，如 I promised (to)；但不能一概而论。并列结构可省重复主语、助动词等，确保剩余结构平行且不改变否定范围。
examples: She speaks Italian, but I don't.
do 替代普通实义动词内容。
I'd like to join you, but I won't be able to.
保留 to，后续可恢复。
He isn't angry, although he seems to be.
主要动词 be 通常保留。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：He is tired, and I do too. → He is tired, and I am too. 原句主要动词是 be，应匹配 am。
quiz: 补全：I didn't call her, although I meant ___.
to。省略重复的 call her。
补全：She hasn't been invited, but her brother ___.
has 或 has been，省略已知的 invited 内容。

lessons.title: 形式 it、强调句与信息焦点
lessons.goal: 区别普通指代、句法占位和刻意突出某个成分。
rules: 形式主语：It is important to check；It seems that...；It surprised me that...。长内容后置让句子更易处理，不意味着所有普通名词主语都能随意搬到 it 后面。
形式宾语常见于 find/consider/think+it+形容词/名词+to do/that：I find it hard to focus。like/hate/appreciate it when/if... 也有固定结构；不能照字面删掉 it。
it 强调句常为 It is/was+焦点+that/who+剩余部分，突出人、物、时间或原因等。it 本身是单数，但关系部分的谓语须按实际主语解释：It is the students who need help。
what 分裂句把所需、所做等内容放到焦点位置：What I need is time。all/the thing/the person... 等也可组织焦点。不要把每个 It is...that... 都认作强调句；形式主语句不能同样还原。
examples: I find it difficult to work with loud music.
it 占据形式宾语位置。
It was Nora who found the mistake.
强调找到错误的人。
What we need is a clear plan.
突出真正需要的东西。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：I find difficult to focus. → I find it difficult to focus. 这一结构需要形式宾语 it。
quiz: 强调时间：I met her on Monday.
It was on Monday that I met her.
It is obvious that he is tired 是强调句吗？
不是。it 是形式主语，that 从句是被后置的内容。

lessons.title: 否定倒装与省略 if 的条件句
lessons.goal: 先判断触发成分的范围，再移动正确的助动词。
rules: never、rarely、seldom、little 等否定/近否定状语置于句首强调时，常用部分倒装：助动词+主语+其他动词。普通一般时态补 do/does/did，主要动词恢复原形。
only+状语、not until 等前置也触发主句倒装。Only when she arrived did we start 中，从句保持普通语序。only 修饰主语时不倒装：Only Eva knew。
hardly/scarcely...when，no sooner...than，not only...but also、under no circumstances 等常见于正式文体。so+形容词 或 such 的前置也可倒装强调。
条件句可省 if 并前置 had/should/were：Had I known；Should you need help；Were she to agree。否定用 Had I not known，不用常规问句式缩写 Hadn't I... 来表达这种条件。
examples: Never have I seen such careful work.
否定状语前置，have 倒装。
Only after the test did we notice the error.
倒装主句，notice 恢复原形。
Had I known the risk, I would have waited.
等于 If I had known...。

Never had I heard that name before.

lessons.title: 地点倒装、前置与篇章衔接
lessons.goal: 把语法用于信息组织，而不是为了复杂而复杂。
rules: 地点/方向表达置首时，可用完全倒装把名词主语放动词后：On the wall hung a portrait；Here comes the bus。代词主语通常不倒装：Here it comes。
某些 as/than 比较结构在正式语体中可倒装：as did her colleagues。普通宾语前置并不自动触发助动词倒装；前置必须有合理对比或已知背景。
however、therefore、nevertheless、meanwhile、moreover、as a result 等连接句间逻辑。连接独立句时通常用句号或分号，不靠一个逗号冒充 and/but。
frankly、fortunately、apparently、presumably 等可评价整句或证据把握；financially、technically 等限定观察角度。副词位置会改变范围：surprisingly well 强调好得意外，Surprisingly,... 评价整件事。
examples: On the desk lay an unopened letter.
地点先行，新信息 letter 放后面。
The plan is expensive; however, it may save time.
分号分开两个独立分句。
Financially, the project is a success.
从财务角度评价，不等于所有方面都成功。
lessons.pitfall: 错误：Here comes it. → Here it comes. 代词主语通常不采用这种完全倒装。
quiz: 改标点：It was late, however, we kept working.

前者评价答对这件事出乎意料；后者突出回答速度快得意外。
